title: 630. Design In-Memory File System

examples.explanation: Listing root shows a; reading the file gives hello; listing its folder shows d.
Root holds x; the folder holds f; the file holds data.

hints: Keep a set of directory paths plus a map from file path to its text.
mkdir adds every missing prefix; adding content creates parent dirs first and appends.
ls on a file returns its name; ls on a directory returns sorted immediate children.
Adaptation: implement runFileSystem(operations, paths, contents); void calls produce no rows, while ls and read each append one row.
